items.title: CANTO: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
items.excerpt: CANTO tokenizes NURBS geometry directly and predicts physical fields without an input mesh. The authors demonstrate differentiable CAD-parameter optimization. First submitted September 29; revision October 1. Research results and benchmark improvements are author-reported.

items.title: Dependable AI-Assisted Engineering: A Formal Framework for AI Participation and Assurance in Safety-Critical Workflows
items.excerpt: A 17-unit wing-spar workflow separates AI generation, deterministic checks, and human judgment. The generated CAD passed 23 checks, but insufficient mesh-convergence evidence prevented automatic acceptance of stress criteria. The author makes no system-safety, certification or productivity claim.

items.title: ReliCAD: From Uncertain LLM Generation to Reliable Parametric CAD Modeling
items.excerpt: ReliCAD converts natural-language requirements into structured design specifications, models geometric and topological dependencies, and invokes a CAD kernel through an agent API for construction and constraint solving. The framework targets reliability and preservation of design intent.

items.title: What Is AI Simulation?

items.title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents

items.title: Introducing Beam: Reflection’s 501B open-weight model

items.title: New KPMG AI Pulse Survey: As AI maturity converges, leading organizations show what AI at scale requires

items.title: AI drives productivity, but CEOs struggle to turn gains into growth

items.title: AI Benefits at Work Unevenly Distributed
